archetypes.name: oos-flow
archetypes.rationale: The diff rewires a multi-stage OOS disposition pipeline where ordering and branch behavior are high-risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the end-to-end OOS disposition flow across the new reference procedure, Step 2 materialization, ship-pr pre-trigger behavior, Python ship behavior, and checkpoint handoff. Pay special attention to sentinel recovery, all-already-filed batches, partial /issue failures, fork and repo-unavailable carve-outs, and whether OOS_PENDING can be cleared or PR creation can proceed prematurely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: manifest-bridge
archetypes.rationale: The new manifest materializer is a correctness-critical bridge from JSON observations to markdown gate inputs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review materialize-manifest-oos.sh and its callers for JSON parsing, idempotency by title, monotonic OOS_N allocation, multiline description rendering, phase handling, and the dedicated focus-area security exclusion predicate. Check whether malformed manifests, empty or absent arrays, duplicate titles with changed content, existing output files, and missing jq/helper cases produce the intended fail-open or fail-closed behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: python-parity
archetypes.rationale: Python ship.py is being aligned with bash ship-pr semantics and may drift subtly at integration boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python ship changes against the bash ship-pr and checkpoint semantics described in the plan. Verify design accepted-OOS path resolution order, pre-_oos_gate materialization, needs_user_reason=oos-filing behavior, helper invocation paths, and whether Python avoids PR creation when manifest-only OOS cannot be materialized. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-flow
archetypes.rationale: Several bash paths add exit-code-sensitive control flow where quoting and set -e interactions can cause hidden regressions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the bash implementation changes for robust control flow, quoting, temporary-file handling, command substitution exit behavior, and interaction with set -euo pipefail. Focus on step2-implement.sh, ship-pr.sh, and the new materialization helper, especially around helper failures, log capture, append-tool-failure calls, and ordering before OOS_PENDING triggers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: evidence-logging
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends on clean separation between gate-visible OOS evidence and post-checkpoint run statistics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the new oos-pipeline documentation, SKILL.md edits, and structure tests preserve the intended ownership boundaries for oos-issues evidence, rejected OOS records, and run-statistics. Check that sentinel recovery and all-already-filed branches still materialize checkpoint-visible evidence without incorrectly recording newly filed counts before the checkpoint passes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
